summary: Sealed club car park beside playing fields and a gravel works yard, no homes.

best_section.where: North edge of the car park, backing onto the gravel yard

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto a gravel works yard and playing fields; only non-residential sheds nearby, no homes in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Open sealed car park off the road along its west side; no gate seen; plenty of bays.
drivers.traffic: Quiet internal car park; only club or yard traffic.
drivers.convention: About a dozen cars parked in it; likely day use by the club.

flags: Slope 4% mean over whole outline; best section about 1.5%
Works yard to the north has trucks and may start early
Waterway 70 m away, ground about 10 m elevation
sun_shade: Open sealed surface; trees shade the east edge in the afternoon.
